evidence_excerpts: Fig. 1 tracks scientific and news media articles on mindfulness and/or meditation by year from 1970 to 2015, using Scopus for empirical scientific articles and LexisNexis for newspaper media pieces.

During the past two decades, mindfulness meditation has gone from being a fringe topic of scientific investigation to being an occasional replacement for psychotherapy, tool of corporate well-being, widely implemented educational practice, and “key to building more resilient soldiers.”
text: Mindfulness and meditation have become widely promoted in clinical, educational, corporate, military, and media contexts despite an evidence base that remains uneven and vulnerable to exaggeration.
